name: Castilla y León
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for
terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Young whites are fresh and fruity, with real presence on the palate.
Rosés are fresh, with red fruit, and those from Prieto Picudo have notable body.
In León and Fermoselle, whole bunches added during fermentation give rosés deeper color and a light sparkle.

blurb.text: A Spanish Vino de la Tierra in the Vino de la Tierra (IGP) category, whose vineyards are dominated by Tempranillo, which makes up half of plantings.
